hero.title: A shared shelf for Azerbaijan’s readers
hero.subtitle: Log the books you read, share reviews and quotes, pick your next book from readers’ recommendations, and order it right here.
hero.quote: “A good book stays with you after the last page.”

problem.title: Who do you talk to about the book you just read?
problem.text: Azerbaijan has no local platform where readers come together. Recommendations are scattered, reviews sit in different languages and places, and buying books outside Baku is still hard.

q1.text: “Both worlds fit within me, yet I do not fit into this world.”

q2.text: “The reading of all good books is like a conversation with the finest minds of past centuries.”
q2.source: René Descartes, Discourse on the Method

q3.text: “All happy families are alike; each unhappy family is unhappy in its own way.”

q4.text: “One sees clearly only with the heart. What is essential is invisible to the eye.”
q4.source: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, The Little Prince

q6.text: “I have always imagined that Paradise will be a kind of library.”

how.title: How Libramigo works
how.subtitle: From finding a book to holding it in your hands — all on one platform.

step1.title: Read and log
step1.text: Add the books you’ve read, the ones you’re reading now, and the ones you want to read to your shelf. Your reading history is always with you.

step2.title: Share
step2.review: “Read it in one sitting. It stays with you long after the last page.”
step2.text: Write reviews, share favorite quotes, follow readers with similar taste and discover their recommendations.

step3.title: Buy
step3.text: Order a book straight from its page. Pay by card, or in cash in Baku, with delivery across Azerbaijan.

avid.title: Avid readers
avid.text: People who log what they read and want to share their take.
avid.benefit1: Your whole reading history in one place

youth.title: Young people and students
youth.text: Readers who love sharing quotes and discovering new books.
youth.benefit1: Collect and share your favorite quotes
youth.benefit2: See what your friends are reading
youth.benefit3: Discover new books through the community

everyone.title: Every reader
everyone.text: Anyone who wants to choose their next book from trusted recommendations.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: Libramigo grows step by step: first the bookstore, then the reader platform, then the mobile app.

stage1.title: Idea stage
stage1.text: The waitlist is open. We’re gathering our first readers.

stage4.title: Mobile app
stage4.item1: Store and platform in one app
stage4.item2: Your shelf and orders on your phone

community.title: Let’s gather around books
community.subtitle: Libramigo won’t be just an app, it will be a place where readers meet. We are preparing the first community formats and will shape them together with our first readers.

club.title: Monthly book club
club.text: Each month we pick one book, read it together and talk it over at the end of the month.

challenge.title: Reading challenges
challenge.text: Set seasonal goals, like 5 Azerbaijani authors this summer, and share your progress with friends.

meetups.title: Live meetups
meetups.text: Face-to-face meetups with fellow book lovers in cafés and bookshops in Baku and the regions.

authors.title: Author talks
authors.text: Open conversations with writers and translators: ask your question directly.

community.callout: Which format should we start with? Join the waitlist: the first invitations go to people on it.

waitlist.title: Be one of the first readers
waitlist.subtitle: Join the waitlist and be the first to know when we open.
